pack.title: Health content
pack.description: Risks and controls for work near patient care: clinical validation, the patient record, alert fatigue, and regulated software.

risks.title: Something wrong is written into a patient's record
risks.description: A generated note, summary, or code contains an error and is filed without a clinician catching it.
risks.treatment: Require a clinician to read, correct, and sign generated text before it is filed, and sample what was filed.

risks.title: Clinicians stop heeding its alerts
risks.description: A tool raises so many flags, or so many wrong ones, that staff dismiss them, including the ones that matter.
risks.treatment: Measure how often alerts are acted on, and tune or withdraw alerts that are mostly dismissed.

risks.title: It was never tested on patients like ours
risks.description: A model validated elsewhere performs differently on this population, this equipment, or this way of recording.
risks.treatment: Validate on local data before use, by the groups of patients it will be used for, and again after any change.

risks.title: The software is a regulated medical device and nobody noticed
risks.description: A tool that informs diagnosis or treatment falls under medical device rules, and is used without the clearance or the controls those rules require.
risks.treatment: Ask of every clinical tool whether it is regulated, record the answer and who gave it, and use it only as cleared.

risks.title: Care stops when the tool does
risks.description: A service comes to rely on a tool, and there is no practiced way to work when it is unavailable or wrong.
risks.treatment: Keep a downtime procedure for each clinical tool and practice it.

risks.title: Patients are not told AI is part of their care
risks.description: AI drafts messages to patients or shapes decisions about them, and they would object if they knew.
risks.treatment: Decide where patients are told, say it plainly there, and give them a way to ask for a person.

control_categories.label: Keep data where it may be

controls.title: A clinician signs what goes in the record
controls.statement: Generated text is read, corrected, and signed by a clinician before it is filed in a patient's record, and a sample of filed text is checked.

controls.title: It is validated on local patients
controls.statement: Before clinical use, performance is measured on local data for the groups of patients concerned, and the result is kept.

controls.title: Whether it is a regulated device is recorded
controls.statement: For each clinical tool, whether it is a regulated medical device, its clearance, and its cleared use are recorded with the name of who decided.

controls.title: A downtime procedure exists and is practiced
controls.statement: Each clinical use has a written way to carry on without the tool, and it has been tried within the year.

controls.title: How often alerts are acted on is measured
controls.statement: For a tool that raises alerts, the share acted on is measured and reviewed, and alerts that are mostly dismissed are changed or withdrawn.
